headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Wisconsin, South Carolina and Minnesota primary results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in South Carolina, Wisconsin, Minnesota and other states while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Democratic Rep. John Larson loses his primary to opponent calling for generational change
headlines.description: The 14-term Connecticut Democrat lost to former Hartford Mayor Luke Bronin in a heavily blue district, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Secret Service operation to swap Trump’s planes amid Iran threat
headlines.description: We are learning new details about the elaborate Secret Service operation to swap President Trump’s planes amid an Iranian assassination threat. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: 3 dead, more than 1 million without power as severe storms strike Midwest
headlines.description: More than 1 million customers were without power in four states as storms with winds gusting more than 80 mph tore down trees and power lines.

headlines.title: Search Underway After Deadly 7.4 Earthquake Strikes Colombia
headlines.description: An urgent search for survivors is underway in Colombia after a powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake took many by surprise Monday morning. Rescuers are desperately digging through mountains of rubble to find those trapped inside buildings, as the death toll climbs to more than 130 people. NBC’s George Solis reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrat backed by Blue Dogs and Bernie Sanders wins primary as parties prepare to battle for the House
headlines.description: Tuesday’s primaries are setting the matchups in around a half-dozen competitive House races that will be key to the fight for the House majority in November, including in a hotly contested Democratic target in Wisconsin.
